description: This file contains functions for extracting and normalizing message content, context, and metadata from WhatsApp messages using the Baileys library, including handling of different message types, context info, and location data.

methods.name: fallbackNormalizeMessageContent
methods.description: Recursively unwraps message wrappers to get the core message content.

methods.name: normalizeMessage
methods.description: Normalizes message content using external or fallback method.

methods.name: fallbackGetContentType
methods.description: Determines the content type of a message using fallback logic.

methods.name: getMessageContentType
methods.description: Gets the message content type, using external or fallback method.

methods.name: extractMessage
methods.description: Extracts the core message from wrappers or content.

methods.name: getFutureProofInnerMessage
methods.description: Retrieves nested inner message if present.

methods.name: buildMessageChain
methods.description: Builds a chain of messages following nested inner messages.

methods.name: unwrapMessage
methods.description: Unwraps message to the most inner message.

methods.name: extractContextInfoFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts context info from a message, including quoted message and location.

methods.name: extractContextInfo
methods.description: Builds message chain and extracts context info from it.

methods.name: extractMentionedJids
methods.description: Extracts mentioned JIDs from a message.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: Extracts text content from a message.

methods.name: extractMediaPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns placeholder string for media types.

methods.name: extractContactPlaceholder
methods.description: Generates placeholder for contact info.

methods.name: describeContact
methods.description: Parses contact info and vcard.

methods.name: formatContactPlaceholder
methods.description: Formats contact placeholder string.

methods.name: formatContactsPlaceholder
methods.description: Formats multiple contacts placeholder string.

methods.name: formatContactLabel
methods.description: Formats contact label with name and phones.

methods.name: formatPhoneList
methods.description: Summarizes and formats list of phone numbers.

methods.name: summarizeList
methods.description: Helper to limit list length and count remaining items.

methods.name: extractLocationData
methods.description: Extracts location info from message, including live and static locations.

methods.name: describeReplyContext
methods.description: Builds reply context info from a quoted message, including body, sender, and ID.
